text: After Mawarti dies of a mysterious illness, her son Tomi sees her at night, and [a fortune teller urges him toward black magic|wrong|bargains with dark powers]. A new housekeeper, Darminah, [arrives, supposedly sent by a friend of their father|trigger|an outsider reaches in], and soon the old servant hangs and Rita's boyfriend dies under a lorry. In the cemetery Tomi watches Darminah [raise his mother from the grave|threat|the dead that rise] and order her to kill her family, who have [little faith left to protect them|rules|faith and charms protect].
